title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0029 R1

summary_points: RFQ for Solana project
Notice of alternate billing cycle available
Confidentiality notice on information and know-how
Quality requirements for all materials
Vendor data commitment with specific deadlines
Monthly shipping schedule by August 2012
Spare parts list required with prices and delivery details
Equipment inspection before shipment mandatory
Alternate quotations invited to improve performance or reduce costs
All transmitters will be calibrated by the vendor.
Accuracy of the calibrated range must be +-1%.
Vendor needs to provide a sunshield.
Process connection is 1/2" Sw for both sample line feed and return.
Sample cooler model TLR/425 and pressure reduction sentry model VREL are required.
The transmitter model is TD 4100CTD with an output range of 0-500 PPB.
The instrument operates at a max working pressure of 250 psig / 212°F.
The transmitter requires an LCD display and special conditioning if needed.
A certificate of calibration is required.
Vendor must provide sunshield, sample conditioning equipment, cooler, and block valve.
Transmitter model: TD 4100CTD, type: 24 VDC / 2 wire, output signal: 4-20 mA HART.
Max working pressure: 250 psig, max temperature: 212°F.
Calibrated range: Temp - max (deg. F) 735.
Manufacturer: Turner designs.
Process data includes line size, material, flowing medium, and component analyzed.
